title: From Ph.D. to National Lab: A Journey into Research, Innovation, and Impact
speaker: Sanjay Das
speaker_role: Postdoctoral Research Associate, Oak Ridge National Laboratory
abstract: What does a research career at a U.S. national laboratory look like, and how does it differ from academia? In this talk, I shared my journey from Ph.D. research to a postdoctoral position at Oak Ridge National Laboratory (ORNL), highlighting my current work on AI for Science and Operations and trustworthy AI systems. I discussed the national laboratory research environment, interdisciplinary collaborations, and how research translates into real-world impact. I also shared insights into career pathways from postdoctoral researcher to research scientist, along with practical advice for graduate students, including international students, interested in research careers at U.S. national laboratories.
